title: Vibe code
summary: Describe a change in a sentence; it lands with security, a build, tests and a change note checked

gates.title: Security
gates.hint: grant the new entities, microflows and pages to the right roles (manage-security skill)

gates.title: Builds
gates.hint: fix the errors mx check reports (the validate-project command)

gates.title: Tests
gates.hint: add or fix a test in tests/ for the logic you changed (test-microflows skill)

gates.title: Quality
gates.hint: see what lowered the score: mxcli report -p <app>.mpr (assess-quality skill)
